title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 54 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 54)

content.overview: Section 54 provides for reference to arbitration where a judicial authority is seized of a matter covered by a Geneva Convention arbitration agreement, subject to the statutory prima facie validity exception.
content.glance: Section 54 provides for reference to arbitration where a judicial authority is seized of a matter covered by a Geneva Convention arbitration agreement, subject to the statutory prima facie validity exception.
content.study:
Section 54 — Power of judicial authority to refer parties to arbitration

Section 54 provides for reference to arbitration where a judicial authority is seized of a matter covered by a Geneva Convention arbitration agreement, subject to the statutory prima facie validity exception.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
